name: Prewarmed gate handles its first request
trigger: A cut-gate schedule causes production reconciliation to complete a gate prewarm, then the first gate request is issued.
observe: production phase reconcile target, actual count, and prewarm duration
first gate request selects the prepared Pod and completes through provider transport
expected: The first eligible gate request reuses the completed phase-prewarmed Pod; no cold fallback or duplicate preparation occurs.
